mapper.select: SELECT id, username, password, nickname, phone, email, status, last_login_time, remark, create_time, update_time, creator, updater, deleted, version FROM sys_user WHERE username = #{username} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET last_login_time = NOW(3), updater = 'system' WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
